checks: repeated-coordinate part with >=3 points but <3 unique coordinates is ineligible
two-point part is retained as an ineligible geometry
closed nonzero path has D=0, D/L=0, and remains eligible
separate nearly straight parts are measured independently and never bridged
longest eligible part wins; exact path tie chooses smaller original part index
source ordinal at the month-1/month-2 boundary maps to month 2 row_index 0
ts key uses validated naive source-clock epoch-hours; no UTC/KST localization
raw RFID or source-hour mismatch raises and blocks row validation
CSV reader preserves quoted row[3] geometry; unrelated extra columns are ignored
explicit nullable Arrow schema writes null-first/valid-second exactly once and one-row output once

ram_preflight.estimate_basis: bounded projected parquet batches, <=99,677 scalar target keys, one month of parsed records, and bounded parquet output batches; R7 observed process peak 334MiB; conservatively reserve 768MiB per active external Python job

scope: synthetic in-memory records and temporary miniature parquet only; no production CSV/parquet, labels, extraction or scoring read
